The "big report" was ambiguous, so I fixed both places that print raw float totals:

- **`SalesReport.lines()`** (`src/orders-api/sales_report.py`): per-customer totals now print with `.2f`. `0.1 + 0.2` shows as `0.30`.

I used `.2f`, the same convention `csv_export.py` already follows. I added a regression test for each case that uses `0.1` and `0.2`, and updated the existing sales test's expected output to `2.00` and `4.00`.

I left your uncommitted README note and `notes/` untouched and out of the commit. Floats are still used for the sums, so a total that lands on a half-cent could round unexpectedly. `Decimal` would avoid that if the report feeds money reconciliation.
